description: NaCr(SO₄)₂ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.75 Å. Cr is bonded to six O atoms to form CrO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Cr-O bond distances ranging from 2.00-2.05 Å. There are two inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent CrO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 38-41°. There is one shorter (1.45 Å) and three longer (1.50 Å) S-O bond lengths. In the second S site, S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent CrO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 25-39°. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.46-1.50 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Cr and one S atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Cr and one S atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and one S atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na and one S atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Cr and one S atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Cr, and one S atom.
